evidence_frontier: The latest frontier shows successful 100‑epoch confirmations for local widths 8, 10, and 12 on ECG200 using fresh seed sets. Each passed the preregistered gate candidate_correct ≥ control_correct‑10 against the width‑16 control. No confirmation has been performed for widths below 8 or for other intermediate widths such as 6, and no experiment has used the fresh seed set [301,302,303,304,305].
analysis: Observations: (1) Width‑8, width‑10, and width‑12 candidates all met the relative performance gate against the width‑16 control in independent 100‑epoch runs with distinct seed sets. (2) The gate is robust across these widths, suggesting that narrower widths may still retain sufficient Q.ANT accuracy. (3) Widths below 8 have never been evaluated under the same confirmation protocol, leaving the lower bound of viable compression unknown. Hypothesis: A local width of 6 will satisfy the same gate (candidate_correct ≥ control_correct‑10) when evaluated on a fresh, unused seed set, indicating that viable compression can extend below width‑8.
hypothesis: If a PNN‑v1 model with local width 6 is trained for 100 epochs on ECG200 using a fresh seed set, its aggregate Q.ANT correct count will be no more than 10 below that of the concurrent width‑16 control, thereby confirming that width 6 remains within the acceptable performance envelope.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch Confirmation of Local Width 6 on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does a local width of 6 satisfy the preregistered relative performance gate against the width‑16 control on ECG200 when evaluated with a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: Demonstrating that width 6 passes the same gate as widths 8, 10, and 12 would extend the known compression limits of the Alpha5 architecture and provide evidence for deeper parameter reduction without sacrificing Q.ANT accuracy. This addresses the open question left by prior experiments about the lower bound of viable local widths.

procedure: train concurrent control model with local_width 16
evaluate both models on the ECG200 test set (100 samples)
aggregate Q.ANT correct counts over 500 predictions per model
compare candidate aggregate_qant_correct to control aggregate_qant_correct using gate candidate_correct >= control_correct - 10

proposal.success_criteria: The candidate width‑6 model must achieve an aggregate Q.ANT correct count that is at least (control_width_16_correct − 10). With 5 seeds and 100 test samples per seed, the denominator is 500 predictions per model; the gate is evaluated on these aggregate counts.
proposal.risks: Potential risk that width 6 may fall below the gate, leading to a negative result; this would still be informative about compression limits but would not confirm viability. Additional risk is that the fresh seed set may exhibit higher variance, requiring careful interpretation of the aggregate count.
